summary:
A 24-wide pale limestone slab (white_terracotta) set narrow-end east toward the plaza and rising to a flat 8-wide crown at y232. Its north and south flanks step back in 2-block ledges (212→218→222→224→228→232), and at the east end they cascade down (196→153→110→41), following the lidar roof map. Every face is fluted with 1-wide piers and recessed dark window strips; it has Top of the Rock glass-parapet decks, a red "GE" sign, a floodlit crown, the WISDOM entrance on the plaza, and a 16-storey Sixth Avenue wing in the same pier language. Pale white_terracotta Art Deco slab fluted by continuous 1-block piers and dark recessed window strips (about 1 in 7 lit), with N/S setback ledges, floodlit crown, Top of the Rock glass-parapet decks, a red GE sign and a mast. East face has the three portals under the WISDOM relief. The low Sixth Avenue wing has lit shopfronts and planted roofs.
elements.md lists 21 elements, and plan.md now has the palette, 18 vocab helpers, rooms and 8 parts.

Massing and shell: parts/massing.mjs builds the union of all plan boxes as a sealed 1-thick white_terracotta inner wall at layer -3, with a roof course over the deep interior. The outer layers 0..-2 and each roof's outer ring are left for the facade and crown parts. The east-entrance backing wall (x143) and reveals (z19, z36) are built.
But ./make.sh does not finish: its automatic roof step crashes (details in left), so there is no whole build.nbt from make.sh yet.
polish: ./make.sh crashes in the automatic roof step (roof.json via reroof). It throws 'Reduce of empty array' in presetOptions, not the 'no walls found' error that build.mjs catches. reroof would also strip everything above one detected eave on this setback massing, so build.mjs should drop roof.json and run with roof undefined, since the wing and crown parts build every roof themselves. With that change the massing alone builds: 57k blocks placed, build saved.
Interior floors are only the ground itself plus smooth_stone at ground level where ground > 0. The shop and lobby floors were not separately built.
$MCD check reports floating groups (the inner wall and roof course) until the facade parts fill layers 0..-2. The wall and roof course connect once they do. Re-run check after parts 2 and 3.
Not done: the fit and walk checks and the render tiles, because make.sh failed. The elements.md item E01 is not ticked, although plan.md's checklist box 1 is.
